SASBDB entry SASDR99  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDR99/)

Publication: Human aromatic amino acid decarboxylase is an asymmetric and flexible enzyme: implication in AADC deficiency
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1002/pro.4732

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDR99/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
